title: Application of Boston Edison Company, under the provisions of G l. c. 164, sec. 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, for aprovial by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of August, September and October of 1988. The fuel charge reflects changes in the prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
